about_the_game:
Organizing a football match is about more than just 90 minutes on the pitch. It’s 14 days of pure pressure! A massive logistical machine where hundreds of thousands of emotional fans flood the city streets. In Copa City, we hand you control over preparing the urban space for this challenge. Forget about player transfers! Your task is to tame the fan groups moving through the city, optimize their placement, and reach the highest possible match readiness while turning a financial profit.

Success in the game hinges on numbers, strategy, and flawless optimization. Copa City offers a logistics and economic simulation where you manage the complex machinery of a mass event. Every decision and every module you place directly affects your finances, fan safety, and key success metrics.

The true heart of the gameplay and the measure of your strategic success are Match Readiness (MR) points. The rule is simple yet demanding: infrastructure without fans, or a crowd without proper security, will get you nowhere. Only perfect synergy: having fans in the city and precisely satisfying their needs across districts opens the path to your desired financial results. Keep risk and profit calculations in mind: each type of fan generates a different amount of MR points.

Your gameplay loop begins on the world map. Plan international marketing campaigns to draw thousands of fans to the city. Once they arrive, you must balance their dynamic needs. Remember the golden rule: supply in a given district must always exceed the demand generated by the crowd!

Control every operational parameter of the stadium from pitch condition and preparing player locker rooms to the logistics of VIP sectors. Sell tickets and maximize revenue, assign sectors to the appropriate fan groups, all while keeping the board's strict and non-negotiable requirements in mind. Track key indicators on the tactical map and ensure that average fan satisfaction doesn't drop below a critical level losing control risks the clubs pulling out of the match, resulting in a game over.

Utilize the dedicated District Panel as your command center and source of truth regarding the city's state. Strategically arrange the placement of merchandise stands, restrooms, and massive Fan Zones, optimizing every square meter. You must constantly adapt your strategy random events and fan marches can drastically and without warning skyrocket the crowd's demands in any given zone.

Forget about managing dry Excel spreadsheets. Thanks to an advanced engine and visuals, you can see the results of your decisions (or mistakes) live. Get a bird's-eye view of thousands of unique fans generating massive city traffic, filling up Fan Zones, and heading toward the stadium. Remember: organizing a match is a high-stakes game. A single strategic blunder can ruin the trust of the football clubs and lead to the highly anticipated football celebration not happening at all.

Copa City isn't about fictional matches on nameless pitches. You will feel the weight of responsibility for organizing highest-stakes events first-hand.

  • Iconic Stadiums and Cities: Take control of realistically recreated districts and legendary arenas (such as the Olympiastadion in Berlin or the Maracanã in Rio). Every city features completely different architecture, unique traffic bottlenecks, and distinct logistical challenges. Get to know the city's topography and its landmarks inside out.

  • Huge Clubs, Titanic Demands: Manage crowds of fans from top-tier football clubs: Arsenal, Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund, Beşiktaş Istanbul, Flamengo Rio de Janeiro, or Olympique de Marseille. Fans from different corners of the globe have distinct temperaments, expectations, and ways of expressing themselves. What works for a peaceful family festival will fail spectacularly during a high-risk match. The game was developed in close cooperation with these football clubs to ensure every detail is perfect: club jerseys, flags, and chants.

    Got feedback or an idea to improve our game? Join our Discord server and stay in touch with us and the entire Copa City community! Also, check out our Wiki, where you'll find plenty of information, explanations, and tips.
requirements_minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT / Intel Arc A770 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
